summary:
Implementation plan for:
1. Zero-Crossing Envelope Detection: Refactor Solfeggio frequency switching to use micro zero-crossing envelope ducking (12ms smooth cosine window) and seamless frequency transitions, mathematically eliminating audio pop artifacts.
2. Real-Time EBU R128 Loudness Analysis Tool & Auto-Leveler: Build an ITU-R BS.1770-4 / EBU R128 dual-stage K-weighting analysis engine and a dedicated floating/docked real-time loudness meter UI with dynamic master volume auto-leveling across ambient nature sound tracks.
3. Purge Commission Earnings & Costs: Clear all existing records from Firestore and localStorage, disable mock data auto-reseeding, and provide a dedicated reset/clear action in the Earnings Dashboard.
